Alex (product): quick flip check-in — what I did / blockers / today
Priya: Done: merged UX copy updates for fallback messaging. Blocker: embed CI flaky in staging, failing intermittently. @Jordan can you look?
Jordan: Worked on canary pipeline; infra gave a transient quota bump so I could run a staging smoke. Need list of models to pin for canary (which quant profiles). @Alex please send. Today: wire up autoscaler policy and tests.
Sam (infra): Confirming dedicated env: 8x A100s available in us-west1 for the canary. Deployed smoke to staging — deploy-bot shows a small latency bump (~40ms median). Need SLA signoff for reserved capacity. :eyes:
deploy-bot: Deployment to staging complete — build 2026.03.17-rc4. Smoke summary: 46 passed, 3 flaky, latency bump noted.
Ivy (qa): QA: smoke passed except rate-limit scenario. Filed ticket #765 for rate-limit config mismatch between staging and dedicated. Blocker: need config sync. Today: re-run regressions after config is aligned.
Samir: +1 on safety — suggest we delay A/B until rollback hooks and metrics alerts are in place. Can't risk perf regression in prod.
Alex (product): Plan: I'll drop the model pin list and rollout checklist in this thread in ~30m and bump PR #312 for reviews. Proposal for prioritization: postpone A/B experiment until rollback + autoscaler validated. Reaction check: :+1: / :-1:?
Priya: +1, also request we update console docs for rollout visibility (per-route latency/slot counts).
Jordan: Will add minimal console docs after autoscaler wiring. ETA EOD today for a first pass.
Alex (product): 👍 thanks all — I'll update the tracker, attach the spec diff, and ping reviewers. If anyone hits more blockers, reply here or DM.
